_: SCAN A SCANNER OUTPUT. Point the source picker at any exp-*.mp4 the scanner made and run this. THE FINDING: a second pass turns ORGANIC warping into RECTILINEAR structure — because the source's x-axis is already TIME, and this pass samples it as SPACE. Marbling comes back as hard slabs and blocks; a beat tape comes back fractured into columns of different moments. RUN IT PERPENDICULAR (axis: horizontal) over a marbled tape for the strangest result the tier makes: staircase and ziggurat edges, checkerboard artefacts, nothing like either input. This is generation loss used deliberately — the loop is closed because a saved clip lands in the media pool, so what the scanner made is immediately something the scanner can read.
